# Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Vin01a)

**ID:** Atk Vin01a
**Section:** Aṭṭhakathā Vinayapiṭake (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (atk-vin01)
**Collection:** Atthakatha-Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā* represents the first major section of the commentary on the Vinaya Piṭaka, forming part of the overarching Vinaya commentary known as the *Samantapāsādikā* [Pranke dissertation]. It constitutes the commentary (*aṭṭhakathā*) specifically dedicated to the *Pārājikakaṇḍa* of the Vinaya [Pranke dissertation]. In traditional and modern Burmese editions (such as the Chaṭṭhasaṅgīti Piṭaka edition), the text is preserved in two volumes under the commentary on the Vinayapiṭaka [Pranke dissertation]. The text includes narrative and historical accounts concerning the transmission of the Dhamma and Vinaya, such as the training of Moggaliputta Tissa under his preceptors in the entire *buddhavacana* along with its commentary [Veidlinger 2007].

According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive internal text reuse across the Pali commentarial and sub-commentarial corpus, with over 86,000 matches shared across 624 texts [DharmaNexus]. Major partners showing substantial verbatim sharing include the *Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā*, *Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā*, sub-commentaries such as the *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā*, *Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā*, *Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā*, and *Vimativinodanī-ṭīkā*, as well as doctrinal treatises such as the *Visuddhimagga* and other major Nikāya commentaries like the *Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches with a significant score are reported [DharmaNexus].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Vinayapiṭake Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā (Tika Vin05t) (§959_1–997_5 ↔ §969–999_5); Pācittiya-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Vin02a1) (§931_0–931_4 ↔ §681_0–681_3); Vinayapiṭake Kaṅkhāvitaraṇīpurāṇa-ṭīkā (Tika Vin09t) (§2685_0–2692_6 ↔ §1315_0–1327_0); Vinayapiṭake Bhikkhupātimokkhapāḷi (Tika Vin04t) (§2574_0–2577_0 ↔ §1843_0–1844_8); Visuddhimaggo (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Anya E0101n) (§1661_3–1705_3 ↔ §1601–1645_3); Vinayapiṭake Sāratthadīpanī-ṭīkā (dutiyo bhāgo) (Tika Vin01t2) (§2893_0–2893_5 ↔ §1594_0–1594_4); Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā (Atk S0517a) (§684_0–690_0 ↔ §783_0–788_10); Vinayapiṭake Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā (Tika Vin11t) (§1528_2–1529_8 ↔ §587_3–589_8)
